contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy coin: nummus from the House of Constantine dating AD318-324. Obverse: Diademed and draped bust right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTIN[---]. Reverse: Wreath with VOT X inside. Reverse inscription: Probably [CAESARVM NOSTRORVM]. Die axis measurement: 7.00. Dimensions: diameter: 18.11mm; weight: 1.73g
